title: Draft International Declaration of Human Rights — Corrigendum to the Summary of amendments proposed to Article 9

pages.text:
United Nations                    Nations Unies                    MASTER FILE
GENERAL ASSEMBLY                  ASSEMBLEE GENERALE               UNRESTRICTED
                                                                   A/C.3/278/Corr.1
                                                                   28 October 1948
                                                                   FRENCH ONLY

                                                                   Dual distribution

Third session
THIRD COMMITTEE

DRAFT INTERNATIONAL DECLARATION OF HUMAN RIGHTS

Corrigendum to the Summary of amendments proposed to Article 9

In the French text of this summary, replace the fourth paragraph by the following text:

Union of Soviet Socialist Republics (E/800)

Replace the word "public" by "which shall be public except in cases expressly provided for in the interest of the protection of morals or of the security of the State".

(This corrigendum also applies to the French text of paragraph 6, page 32, of document E/800)

-----

uncertain.issue: Left margin of the scan is cut off; the first letters of both lines are missing but the words are unambiguous.

uncertain.issue: Left margin cut off at the start of these lines; reconstructed from context ("paragraphe", "expressément", "l'Etat").

uncertain.french: dans l'intérêt de la défense de la morale
uncertain.issue: "défense de la morale" rendered as "protection of morals"; "defence of morality" would be a more literal alternative.
